description:
Returns the user's work experience records with their integer IDs.

Use this tool BEFORE calling `add_career_entry` or `update_career_entry` to find the
correct `experience_id` for the role the entry belongs to. Present the role list to
the user and confirm which one they mean before saving.

This is the tool-based alternative to the `gighq://experience` resource and works in
all contexts including voice mode.
name: list_experiences
